sources.title: NIST SP 800-84: test, training and exercise programs
sources.titleEn: NIST SP 800-84: test, training and exercise programs
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: NIST 零信任架構：每次請求的政策決策與執行
related.titleEn: NIST zero trust: per-request policy decisions and enforcement
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付10目標評估表、注入卡、角色紀錄、復原驗收、三項改善及第二輪比較。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver ten objective assessments, inject cards, role records, recovery acceptance, three improvements and second-round comparison.
related.difference: 畫出學院成績服務的學徒、裝置、政策引擎與執行點；列角色通過、裝置合格、工作階段有效三項 AND 條件，逐一推演八列真值表。
related.differenceEn: Map learner, device, policy engine and enforcement point for a grade service; enumerate the eight truth-table rows for role, device posture and session validity joined by AND.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 演練達標率=具備證據的達標目標/預先定義目標；完成劇情不等於全部能力已驗證。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 演練有10個目標：證明驗證2、分流2、保全2、復原2、溝通2；首輪7個有證據達標。 首輪達標率7/10=70%；三個缺口分別要有原因與補測。
只要必要條件之一不成立便拒絕；聯集計數需扣除同時失敗者，不能把重複拒絕算成額外使用者。 合成的100次請求皆在有效時段；12次角色不符、8次裝置不符，其中3次同時不符。 拒絕12+8−3=17次，允許100−17=83次；裝置不符改15、重疊改5時，允許78次。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Exercise attainment counts evidenced objectives over predefined objectives; finishing the story does not validate every capability. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Ten objectives cover two each for provenance, triage, preservation, recovery and communication; seven have evidence in the first round. First-round attainment=70%; each of three gaps needs a reason and retest.

Deny when any required condition fails; union counts subtract overlapping failures rather than treating duplicate denials as additional people. In 100 synthetic in-window requests, 12 fail role, 8 fail device posture, and 3 fail both. Deny 12+8−3=17 and allow 83; with 15 device failures and overlap 5, allow 78.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SCIM：離職停權、冪等同步與身分殘留
related.titleEn: SCIM: deprovisioning, idempotent sync and identity residue
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付10目標評估表、注入卡、角色紀錄、復原驗收、三項改善及第二輪比較。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver ten objective assessments, inject cards, role records, recovery acceptance, three improvements and second-round comparison.
related.difference: 建立虛構HR、IdP與兩個應用程式的身分關聯表；區分停用、刪除、移除群組與撤銷既有工作階段，定義每一步成功證據。
related.differenceEn: Map fictional HR, IdP and two application identities; distinguish disabling, deletion, group removal and existing-session revocation, with evidence for each.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 演練達標率=具備證據的達標目標/預先定義目標；完成劇情不等於全部能力已驗證。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 演練有10個目標：證明驗證2、分流2、保全2、復原2、溝通2；首輪7個有證據達標。 首輪達標率7/10=70%；三個缺口分別要有原因與補測。
串行最壞停權延遲=來源偵測等待+同步排程等待+目標套用時間；這是所設教學流程的上限，不是SCIM協定保證。 來源最多5分鐘偵測、同步最多10分鐘等待、目標2分鐘套用；假設三階段串行且無重試。 最壞延遲5+10+2=17分鐘；同步等待縮為3分鐘後為10分鐘。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Exercise attainment counts evidenced objectives over predefined objectives; finishing the story does not validate every capability. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Ten objectives cover two each for provenance, triage, preservation, recovery and communication; seven have evidence in the first round. First-round attainment=70%; each of three gaps needs a reason and retest.

Serial worst-case deprovisioning delay is source detection wait plus sync wait plus target application time; it bounds this teaching workflow, not SCIM itself. Detection waits at most 5 minutes, sync waits 10 and target application takes 2; assume serial stages without retries. Worst-case delay is 5+10+2=17 minutes; reducing sync wait to 3 yields 10 minutes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
